test_title: PYST 10 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 15 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Six boys A, B, C, D, E and F go to gym on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday (not necessarily in the same order). No two boys go on the same day. D does not go on Wednesday and Saturday. Neither D nor E goes on Friday. A goes on Tuesday. C goes before D and after B. Which of the following combination of boy and day is correct?
solution:
Boys: A, B, C, D, E, F

Days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday

A → Tuesday

D ≠ Wednesday, Saturday

D ≠ Friday

E ≠ Friday

C goes before D and after B

Logical arrangement method

Days order: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday

A → Tuesday

D ≠ Wednesday, Friday, Saturday

⇒ D → Monday or Thursday

C before D and after B

D cannot be Monday (no day before Monday for B and C)

⇒ D → Thursday

B before C and C before D

⇒ B → Monday

⇒ C → Wednesday

Remaining days: Friday, Saturday

E ≠ Friday

⇒ E → Saturday

⇒ F → Friday

**∴ Correct combination: F → Friday. **

Hence the correct answer is **Option 2.**
